description.narrative: The activities proposed are designed to provide an integrated and coherent response to the needs of 600 HHs (3000 p) among the displaced in the camps of the metropolitan area of PaP. CA and partners will coordinate with camp committee members for implementation. Activities will include: 1. MPC: Two rounds of MPC will be provided to each 255 HH in camps in PaP. Based on our experience the delivery mechanism will be via mobile money provider. 2. WASH - Access to water in the camps will be improved by installing water storage tanks for clean water distribution to families. Tanks will be strategically located for easy access, crucial given rising cholera cases and the upcoming rainy season. A partnership with a local water company will ensure continuous clean water supply. Families will also receive individual storage containers and hygiene kits (2 storage containers once and 2 hygiene kits distribution cycles) containing essentials like soap, toothpaste, feminine hygiene items and baby products. Contracts with local suppliers will streamline kit distribution using secure coupons, minimizing transport risks. Throughout the project, protection will be mainstreamed: targeted individuals with additional protection needs will be supported to access specialized protection services (referral) throughout the program cycle. Individuals identified at displaced household level with protection needs will receive appropriate referrals. Collaborating with partners specializing in protection will ensure effective and rapid referral of beneficiaries to essential services.
